entities.name: Galazeth Prismari
entities.description: One of the five elder dragons of Arcavios who founded Strixhaven; Prismari College is named for him; a master of elemental energies expressed through art.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: Institution founded by the five elder dragons to study the five mana dichotomies.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane born when Ezroi and Karudis merged.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: The five elder dragons hatched from mana vortices on Arcavios.

entities.name: Prismari College
entities.description: Strixhaven college named in Galazeth's honor.

events.summary: Five dragons hatched from luminous spheres of overlapping mana at the birth of Arcavios.
events.quote: from which were hatched five dragons

events.summary: Around 3861 AR Prismari proposed founding an institution that became Strixhaven.
events.quote: Prismari had the idea for the dragons to found an institution

relations.quote: The founding of Strixhaven was initially Galazeth's idea
